# ~/.zshrc — Marcel Spatz

# ─── T7 exFAT metadata prevention ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Prevents macOS from writing ._* AppleDouble resource-fork files to exFAT volumes
# (like the T7 SSD). Without this, every 'cp' to T7 generates a ghost ._file.
export COPYFILE_DISABLE=1
export COPY_EXTENDED_ATTRIBUTES_DISABLE=1

# Alias to manually clean any ._* files that sneak in via Finder or GUI apps
alias dot_clean_t7='find /Volumes/T7 -name "._*" -type f -not -path "*/RECOVERY/*" -delete && echo "T7: ._* files cleaned"'

# ─── Homebrew ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"

    echo "Usage: auto research \"your topic here\""
  fi
}
